```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

yo_mama <- ggplot(penguins, aes(x = body_mass_g, y = bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Bill Length vs. Body Mass by Species",
    x = "Body Mass (g)",
    y = "Bill Length (mm)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

yo_mama
```
